I found both. Before I set this up, what type of access should Sarah have to the info@harborpointdental.test mailbox?

1. **Full Read Access** — can read/manage emails but cannot send as the mailbox
2. **Full Read Access + Send As** — can read/manage emails AND send emails as the info mailbox
